draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base extends to all three customer-service domains not seen in training (Insurance 85.7 vs 81.2, Telecom 83.9 vs 80.4, Utilities 86.2 vs 82.0 macro-F1).
rationale: T1.r3-r5 show Wrenfold beats Fennick-Base on all three held-out domains (85.7/81.2, 83.9/80.4, 86.2/82.0). The sentence's "may extend" is weaker than the evidence, which shows the advantage on every held-out domain. No statistical test is reported, so "may" hedging is appropriate, but the claim can be strengthened to state the observed advantage on all held-out domains.
